mission_03: Excellent! You have successfully applied UMAP for dimensionality reduction. You learned how UMAP combines the strengths of t-SNE (local structure preservation) with better global structure retention and faster computation. UMAP's key advantages include scalability to larger datasets, support for transforming new data points, and better preservation of the global data topology. These properties make UMAP suitable not just for visualization but also as a preprocessing step in ML pipelines. When choosing between t-SNE and UMAP, prefer UMAP for production use and t-SNE for exploratory analysis.
